result.question: What does the man of God say to the king?

readings.answer: That even if given half the king’s possessions, he would not go with him or eat or drink there.
readings.support: If you were to give me half your possessions, I still would not go with you, nor would I eat bread or drink water in this place.

assessments.reason: Verse 13:8 states, 'I still would not go with you,' matching the key; the answer’s added details about not eating or drinking are also in the text.

result.reason: The passage explicitly records the man of God telling the king he would not go with him.
